messages.subject: Proposal for GSoC2013: robgpu
parts:
Hi everybody,

I took the liberty of adding a project proposal to the
http://rwiki.sciviews.org/doku.php?id=developers:projects:gsoc2013
page of the R wiki.

The project is about using the CUDA framework for highly parallelized
implementations of computationally intensive robust statistical
methods such that the methods can be applied to data sets that are
large in the number of variables or observations. I would serve as the
mentor and I already found an interested and highly qualified student.

This is the first time that I propose a GSoC project, so any feedback
on the proposal is of course welcome.

Thanks to everybody involved for organizing the R project participation in GSoC!

Best regards,
Andreas
